item.title: Luzerne County modifies 4 projects awarded $1.6M in COVID-19 recovery funds
item.description: Luzerne County has approved modifications to four projects awarded a total of $1.6 million in COVID-19 recovery funds.

item.title: Temple University commits to location for Tamaqua dental school, student apartments
item.description: The location of a new Temple University dental school and clinic in downtown Tamaqua was formally committed to by university Trustees Wednesday, progressing plans to boost the accessibility of quality dental care in underserved rural communities in the region. item.title: Flyers fight back for point in OT loss to Kings
item.description: If the Flyers have designs on the playoffs, they are going to need more performances like the one they put forth Saturday at Xfinity Mobile Arena.

item.title: National tour of the musical ‘Kinky Boots’ to play Scranton
item.description: The production comes to the Scranton Cultural Center at the Masonic Temple in February; a cast member says seeing the show as a teenager changed his life.

item.title: AHL: Depth, development are pillars to Penguins’ success
item.description: Entering the weekend, the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins didn’t have an active skater inside the top 90 among the American Hockey League’s scoring leaders. item.title: Dice and decks turn local hobby shops into community hubs
item.description: As digital entertainment, social media and artificial intelligence isolate people from each other, in-person tabletop and trading card games are bringing them together.

item.title: COMMUNITY DIGEST: Feb. 1, 2026
item.description: Greater Hazleton Area and beyond District 12 Sons of American Legion meeting: 2 p.m. Sunday, Feb. 1. American Legion Post 350, Nanticoke. Weather permitting. All squadrons are asked to attend since there will be very important new information to be presented. District Commander Len Biel will preside; agenda includes future fundraising and veterans events. All SAL members are encouraged to attend and may contact District Adjutant in case of inclement weather. Refreshments to follow. Hazleton Art
